Investigate the statute of limitations in your area.  15 years sounds like in most places it is past the allowable time a debt collector can legally collect or report it on your credit report. The statute of limitations means you still owe the debt, but they collector can no longer use the court system to collect it from you.  They can file a lawsuit, they will just lose.
